description: This file implements a watcher for devicemapper thin pools, managing cache of device usage and metadata reservation using thin_ls and dmsetup commands.

classes.name: usageCache
classes.description: A thread-safe cache storing device ID strings mapped to usage values (uint64).

classes.name: ThinPoolWatcher
classes.description: Maintains a cache of device usage stats and manages metadata reservation for a devicemapper thin pool.

methods.name: NewThinPoolWatcher
methods.description: Creates a new ThinPoolWatcher instance for a specified pool and metadata device.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the watcher loop, periodically refreshing device usage data.

methods.name: GetUsage
methods.description: Retrieves the cached usage value for a specific device ID.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Performs a thin_ls operation and updates the cache, managing metadata reservation.

methods.name: checkReservation
methods.description: Checks if the thin device is currently holding userspace metadata by inspecting dmsetup status output.
